rules.half_open: Planned windows and binding intervals are half-open [start, end); a reading exactly at a window end belongs to the next window, if any.
rules.candidate_rule: A reading is eligible for a window only if its UTC instant is inside the half-open window AND at that instant the reading's meter has a valid binding whose point_id equals the window point_id. A reading whose active bindings name several points is eligible for each of those points' windows but is never selected, because its attribution is ambiguous. A window with two or more eligible readings, or with an ambiguous-binding reading, is pending_review. A window with exactly one unambiguous eligible reading is matched only when that reading is eligible for no other window; otherwise every window sharing the reading is pending_review. A window with no eligible reading is missed. A reading can be selected for at most one window. Nearest-time selection is never performed.

status_meaning.pending_review: 窗口有多条候选读数，或读数/窗口归属不能唯一判定；不做静默挑选
status_meaning.missed: 窗口没有任何有效候选读数

rules.selection_rule: a reading is selected only when it is the single unambiguous candidate of exactly one window
rules.duplicate_reading_rule: one reading may be selected for at most one window
